lifecycle.confirmDescription: Recovery is free and ends at the existing fixed D+37 deadline. Activation does not extend it. Guest access, WO/EO access, camera capture, sharing, package upgrades, and rescheduling remain closed. Photo restore already ended at D+30. During recovery, only the Owner can view remaining media, download individual photos, and create a recovery ZIP.

lifecycle.cleanupOnly: User access has ended. Only infrastructure cleanup continues during the cleanup window.
